inputText: This is Pe — PEH. Sound: P as in pen with a dot; F as in fun without the dot. Shape hook: rounded mouth with one tooth. Tip: Its clearly visible internal tooth separates Pe from Kaf; curved wall separates it from Bet; do not mix it up with Kaf, Bet.
